ITEM.PTXT: In the G menu, menus that match the user's purpose or interests can be searched for and executed from an extensive range of menus divided into categories.

ENTRY.PTXT: Because it is connected to a variety of information updated daily, the latest spot information can be obtained at any time. In addition, spot information can be set directly as the navigation destination.
News, weather and other information you want to know now can be searched and displayed in real time.
Games, etc. can be enjoyed in the vehicle.

A variety of communication services that allow sending and receiving e-mail with a dedicated e-mail address as well as home and other e-mail addresses, and exchanging information with friends on bulletin boards.
Services useful when trouble occurs, such as referral to JAF

HINT.PTXT: Menu configuration and contents may be changed without notice to improve operability.

ITEM.PTXT: The G menu provides dozens of extensive G-BOOK.com contents. Examples are given below.

ENTRY.PTXT: If a drive plan is created on the G-BOOK.com or GAZOO.com site using a PC or cellular phone, the destination can be set simply by downloading it to the on-board unit. In addition, in conjunction with the map information service, spots searched for using a PC or cellular phone can be registered as G memory points and set as destinations.
From the Walker magazine series, eating places nationwide, from stylish restaurants to ramen shops, can be searched widely.
Provides information on delicious ramen shops nationwide. Popular shop rankings are also displayed.

Displays the latest traffic information, such as congestion and traffic restriction information for expressways nationwide. Expressway information in the surrounding area can be easily searched simply by entering the name of the expressway, interchange or junction for which you want traffic information.
A game in which users compete in rankings with points accumulated according to distance traveled.
By registering the account of the e-mail address used at work or home, new messages can be received and new messages can be sent.
The current vehicle position registered in the G-BOOK Center can be notified to a third party by e-mail.

When trouble such as an accident occurs, a report is made to the HELPNET Center from the hands-free system via the public network; the HELPNET Center then quickly and accurately transmits the information necessary for emergency rescue activities to rescue agencies (fire, police) and arranges emergency vehicles.
Guidance on maintenance, periodic inspections and vehicle inspections according to vehicle condition, and information on events held by dealers, etc. can be displayed.

A vehicle-exclusive service that provides road service with arrangement of rescue vehicles in the event of trouble such as an accident or breakdown. When activated in the event of trouble, the G-BOOK Support Center determines the vehicle location information and responds quickly.
Online shopping can be enjoyed on the G-BOOK.com exclusive e-commerce site, which handles carefully selected products from the GAZOO.com shopping mall.

HINT.PTXT: The items listed here are only a few examples of G-BOOK.com contents. In addition, contents will be added and changed successively.
